_about: The weapon's upgrade window and its button say Attachments, not Optics (the owner, 2026-10-21: 'it should also be not called optics and be called attachments'; srp-026g/docs/notes/weapon-camo.md, The weapon's upgrade window). The lobby movie's key scope_window_title (the weapon's button in the item panel and the inventory's menu, the title of the window's Attachments page) is mapped to a new text st_srp_attachments in the six localization tables instead of st_srp_optics (patch 19's 'Optics', which nothing else uses). The Appearance page's title is armour's btn_upgrade_label, unchanged.
